agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider: Edmonds Community Resource Centre vacancy update
agenda_briefs.summary: Council is set to hear a delegation from the Canadian Purpose Economy Project about building a 'purpose economy' in Burnaby. The main purpose of this update is to inform the Social Planning Committee about the current vacancy at the Edmonds Community Resource Centre. This is a proposed discussion, not a final decision — no new rules or fees are being voted on yet.
agenda_briefs.action_required: No action needed now — this is an informational update, not a decision affecting your business.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider Journey Home Community Furniture Bank Initiative
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to hear a delegation about the Journey Home Community Furniture Bank Initiative. This is a proposal to support a furniture bank that helps people in need. Council will consider the initiative at an upcoming meeting, but no decision has been made yet. If approved, it could affect how furniture donations and distribution are handled in the community.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Attend the council meeting or contact your councillor to show support or ask questions about the initiative.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider Edmonds Community Resource Centre vacancy
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to receive a verbal update on the vacancy at the Edmonds Community Resource Centre. This is an informational report to the Social Planning Committee, meaning no decision is being made at this time. The update will cover the current status of the vacant space and what it means for the community. Business owners in the Edmonds area may want to pay attention to this, as the future use of the space could affect local foot traffic and community services.
agenda_briefs.action_required: No action needed now — monitor council updates for future decisions on the Edmonds Community Resource Centre space.
